=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md: deleted file mode 120000 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Deleting the symlink breaks the consumer CLAUDE.md sync and tests or scripts that rely on the template path.
  WHY: The sync workflow uses this path to copy the root CLAUDE.md to consumer repositories, and multiple tests and scripts expect the symlink to exist.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:2209 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The test reads workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md after the PR deletes that path.
  WHY: With the symlink absent, TEMPLATE_CLAUDE_MD.read_text() raises FileNotFoundError and fails CI.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml:836 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The activation-verification engine resolution supplies empty AI_ENGINE_LABELS, so an ai:codex label on the PR cannot take precedence over the Claude default.
  WHY: Reviewers disagree on whether the label is available to this path: Deepseek says these specific workflows do not receive issue labels, while the other reviewers identify the merged PR as a label-bearing work item.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh: lines 509-514 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The Claude triage path does not pass MODEL_EDITOR or MODEL_REASONING_EFFORT as AI_ENGINE_MODEL_HINT or AI_ENGINE_EFFORT_HINT.
  WHY: The reviewers say a configured Claude model or effort is therefore ignored on that path; Deepseek disputes the runtime impact, stating that Claude selects its model from claude_engine.json and that the cited override works through engine selection instead.
- .github/workflows/check_failure_triage.yml: lines 437-444 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup retains the claude-pool-token directory when it is a non-symlink directory and uses find … -exec rm -rf to remove other staged files.
  WHY: The reviewer states that this introduces no additional implicit-execution path and that no additional safeguards appear necessary.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Check that the consumer wrappers in workflow-templates/ need no new input. If one would, stop and report it in the PR description: that wrapper is out of this item's scope."
  expected_change_site: The PR description
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: workflow-templates/ai-issue-pr-status.yml grants only issues: write and lacks id-token: write; the changelog fragment documents this limitation, but the supplied PR description does not.
- requirement: The four roles default to Claude, with Claude credentials fetched where needed; add id-token: write where the pool fetch requires it.
  expected_change_site: workflow-templates/ai-issue-pr-status.yml
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The wrapper grants only issues: write at lines 8-10 and does not grant id-token: write; the updated reusable workflow's Claude credential step requires that permission for consumer PR-mode activation runs.
- requirement: "Fetch the relevant commits from PRs #6209 and #6615, port only the needed hunks, and list every reused commit SHA in the PR description."
  expected_change_site: PR description
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The supplied PR description contains automated-implementation text and issue references but lists no reused commit SHAs from PRs #6209 and #6615.
- requirement: “Workflows: ... `unblock_judge.yml` install the pinned CLI and fetch the pool only when the role resolves to Claude.”
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The PR does not modify this workflow; the `Install Claude Code CLI` and `Resolve Claude credential` steps at lines 128-138 have no engine-selection condition.
- requirement: The four roles (`WORKFLOW_HEAL`, `CHECK_TRIAGE`, `ACTIVATION_VERIFY`, `UNBLOCK_JUDGE`) default to Claude, with the work-item label precedence preserved.
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml` "Resolve AI engine" step (line 836) and `.github/workflows/check_failure_triage.yml` "Resolve AI engine" step (line 283) and `.github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml` "Resolve AI engine" step (line 186)
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: All three workflow-level engine-resolution steps hard-code `AI_ENGINE_LABELS: ""`; the reviewer says this bypasses ai:codex precedence for PR-mode activation verification, while check-failure triage and workflow-heal intake work items carry no labels.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  PROBLEM: The PR accidentally deletes the workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md symlink, breaking the consumer CLAUDE.md sync.
  WHY: update_workflows.yml uses this path to sync the root CLAUDE.md to consumer repositories.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Check that the consumer wrappers in workflow-templates/ need no new input. If one would, stop and report it in the PR description: that wrapper is out of this item's scope."

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md: PR diff deletes workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md symlink
  PROBLEM: Deleting this symlink breaks tests and the consumer CLAUDE.md sync mechanism.
  WHY: Consumer repositories rely on this symlink to receive updates, and internal tests expect it to exist in the templates directory.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh: Claude engine path fails to stage SUPPORT_INSTRUCTIONS_FILE
  PROBLEM: The Claude engine path sets SUPPORT_INSTRUCTIONS_FILE to unattended_system_instructions.md in the trusted support directory, but the staging step in check_failure_triage.yml does not copy this file.
  WHY: The Claude engine will run without the required system instructions file, which may cause fallback to codex or failure.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh: Claude path does not pass MODEL_EDITOR or MODEL_REASONING_EFFORT as engine hints
  PROBLEM: The engine resolution and subsequent tool calls do not use the operator-provided model and effort hints for the Claude path.
  WHY: The configured overrides for triage are ignored.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- .github/workflows/check_failure_triage.yml, .github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml, .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml: AI_ENGINE_LABELS is set to an empty string in the env
  PROBLEM: Setting AI_ENGINE_LABELS to an empty string prevents label precedence from correctly selecting Codex when an item is labeled ai:codex.
  WHY: Items labeled ai:codex will resolve to the new Claude default instead of Codex.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The four roles default to Claude, with Claude credentials fetched where needed; add id-token: write where the pool fetch requires it.
  Expected change site: workflow-templates/ai-issue-pr-status.yml
  Evidence of absence: The consumer wrapper grants only issues: write and does not grant id-token: write. The updated reusable workflow’s Claude credential step therefore cannot obtain a pool credential in consumer PR-mode activation runs; because the step continues on error, those runs fall back to Codex. The changelog explicitly documents this limitation, but the wrapper change is absent.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Fetch the relevant commits from PRs #6209 and #6615, port only the needed hunks, and list every reused commit SHA in the PR description.
  Expected change site: PR description
  Evidence of absence: The supplied PR description contains only the automated-implementation text and issue references; it lists no reused commit SHAs.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
